summary: Allogene Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting termination of an exclusive license agreement with Overland parties and entry into a Second Amended and Restated Shareholders Agreement. The license, for CAR T therapies in certain Asian territories, was terminated without consideration; Allogene surrendered equity and will retain ~3% of Overland. No termination payments were made. The restructuring alters Allogene's ownership and governance rights. This is not a standard special situation like an acquisition or spin-off; it is a contract termination and equity restructuring. Watch for any subsequent strategic moves by Allogene.
